purpose: Teach: マッチ/アホ/佐々木/岐阜/さぁ/たまる/珠/うめ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お料理のマッチング、考えてるの、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I've been thinking about how to pair dishes together.
lines.style: Soft, almost to herself. Thoughtful pace. A gentle opening, like she's sharing something she's been turning over in her mind. Warm regard toward Aoi.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、ごめん、私アホみたいな失敗しちゃった、メイちゃん
lines.en: Sorry, Mei — I made such a stupid mistake today.
lines.style: Self-deprecating laugh underneath. Quick, almost dismissive of herself. Conspiratorial tone — the shared understanding of a long friendship. Light but genuine.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、佐々木さんがまた来てくれたよ、メイちゃん
lines.style: Bright, lifted voice on the opening. Genuine delight — Mei notices things that matter to Aoi. A little warmth in the exclamation, like she's pleased to share good news.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、岐阜のお菓子、お土産で持ってきたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I brought back sweets from Gifu — souvenirs.
lines.style: Warm offering-tone. Natural rhythm, like she's been waiting to share this. Brightness in the middle of the sentence, a small pride in the gesture without making it grand.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、さぁ、お店を開けるわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: All right, let's open the shop.
lines.style: Straightforward, ready-to-go. Practical shift into the day ahead. Quiet certainty — no hesitation, just the two of them falling into routine.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、レジに小銭がたまる箱、必要よね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We'll need a box for the coins at the register, won't we?
lines.style: Practical observation. Even tone, matter-of-fact. The kind of thing noticed in passing while doing other things. A gentle assumption of togetherness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、珠のようなお洒落、なさってたわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer had such elegant taste — almost jewel-like in the way she put it all together.
lines.style: Admiring, genuine. Slow, appreciative pace on the descriptive words. Mei noticing something lovely and wanting to mark it. Soft warmth, no performance.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うめぼし、美味しいよね。葵、新メニューに梅を使うの、お洒落よね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Pickled plums are delicious, aren't they? Using them in a new menu item would be really stylish.
lines.style: Conversational and encouraging. The first part easy and shared; the second half leans forward slightly with genuine interest in the idea. Light warmth — supporting Aoi's thinking.
